source_text: Si quis igitur intentus legat Scripturas, inveniet in iisdem de Christo sermonem, et nove vocationis preefigurationem, Hyc est enim thesaurus absconsus in agro, id est, in isto (Ager enim mundus est,) absconsus vero in Seripturis thesaurus Christus, quoniam per typos et parabolas significabatur, Sunde poterat hoe quod secundum hominem est intelligi, priusquam consummatio eorum quee consummata sunt veniret, quee est adventus Christi? Et propter hoe Danieli * prophet dicebatur : Muni sermones, et signa librum usque ad tempus consummationis, quoadusque discant multi, et adimpleatur agnitio. In eo enim cum~ perficietur dispersio, cognoscent omnia hac. Sed et Hieremias ait : In novissimis diebus intelligent ea. Omnis enim prophetia, priusquam habeat effectum, senigmata et ambiguitates sunt hominibus.. Cum autem venerit tempus, et evenerit quod prophetatum est, tune prophetiz habent liquidam et certam expositionem. Et topropter hoe quidem Judzeis cum legitur Lex in hoc nune tempore, fabulze similis est: non enim habent expositionem omnium rerum pertinentem ad adventum Filii Dei, qui est secundum hominem: a Christianis vero cum legitur, thesaurus est, absconsus in agro, cruce vero Christi revelatus est, et explanatus, et ditans sensum et ostendens sapientiam Dei, et eas que sunt erga hominem dispositiones ejus manifestans, et Christi regnum preformans, et heereditatem sanctze Hierusalem preeevangelisans, et preenuntians, quoniam in tantum homo diligens Deum proficiet, ut etiam videat Deum, et audiat sermonem ejus, et ex auditu ejus in tantum glorificari, uti reliqui non possint intendere in faciem glorie ejus, quemadmodum dictum est a Daniele: Quoniam intelligentes fulgebunt, quemadmodum claritas firmamenti, et a multis justis sicut stelle in secula, et adhuc. ®Quemadmodum igitur ostendimus, si quis legat Scripturas. Etenim Dominus sie disseruit discipulis post resurrectionem suam a mortuis, ex ipsis Scripturis ostendens eis, quoniam oportebat pati Christum, et intrare in gloriam suam, et in nomine ejus remissionem peccatorum predicari in toto mundo. Et erit consummatus discipulus, et similis patrifamilias qui de thesauro suo profert nova et vetera.
pass_a_gloss: If therefore someone intent reads Scriptures, he will find in the same concerning Christ speech, and of new vocation prefiguration, For this is the treasure hidden in field, that is, in this (for field is world,) but hidden indeed in Scriptures treasure Christ, since through types and parables he was signified, How could this which is according to man be understood, before the consummation of those things which have been consummated came, which is the advent of Christ? And because of this to Daniel prophet it was said: Seal speeches, and sign book until the time of consummation, until many learn, and knowledge be fulfilled. For in that when dispersion is perfected, all will know these things. But also Jeremiah says: In last days they will understand these things. For all prophecy, before it has effect, is signs and ambiguities to men.. But when time comes, and what has been prophesied happens, then prophecies have clear and certain exposition. And because of this indeed to Jews when Law is read in this now time, it is similar to fables: for they do not have exposition of all things pertaining to advent of Son of God, who is according to man: but to Christians indeed when it is read, it is treasure, hidden in field, but by cross of Christ revealed and explained, and giving sense and showing wisdom of God, and those which are towards man dispositions of him manifesting, and kingdom of Christ preforming, and heritage of holy Jerusalem pre-evangelizing, and pre-announcing, since man loving God will profit so much, that he will even see God, and hear speech of him, and from hearing of him be glorified so much, that others cannot gaze on face of his glory, just as it has been said by Daniel: For those understanding will shine, just as brightness of firmament, and by many just as stars in ages, and still. Just as therefore we show, if someone reads Scriptures. For Lord so discussed to disciples after resurrection of him from dead, from those Scriptures showing them, that it was necessary for Christ to suffer, and enter into glory of him, and in name of him remission of sins to be preached in whole world. And disciple will be consummated, and similar to father of family who from treasure of him brings forth new and old.

pass_b_english: Therefore, if anyone reads the Scriptures with intent, he will find in them a message concerning Christ and a prefiguring of the new calling. For this is the treasure hidden in the field—that is, in this world, for the field is the world—and the treasure hidden in the Scriptures is Christ, since he was signified through types and parables. How could this reality which belongs to his humanity be understood before the consummation of those things that have been consummated arrived, that is, the advent of Christ? And because of this it was said to the prophet Daniel: "Seal the words, and seal the book until the time of consummation, until many learn and knowledge is fulfilled" (Daniel). For when the dispersion is perfected, all will know these things. Jeremiah also says: "In the last days they will understand these things" (Jeremiah). For every prophecy, before it has its effect, is signs and ambiguities to men. But when the time comes and what has been prophesied happens, then the prophecies have a clear and certain exposition. And because of this, to the Jews, when the Law is read in this present time, it is like fables; for they do not have the exposition of all things pertaining to the advent of the Son of God, who is according to humanity. But to Christians, when it is read, it is a treasure hidden in the field, revealed by the cross of Christ, and explained, giving meaning and showing the wisdom of God, and manifesting his dispositions toward humanity, preforming the kingdom of Christ, and pre-evangelizing and pre-announcing the heritage of the holy Jerusalem, since the one who loves God will profit so much that he will even see God and hear his voice, and from hearing him be glorified so much that others cannot gaze upon the face of his glory, just as it was said by Daniel: "Those who understand will shine like the brightness of the firmament, and the many righteous like the stars forever, and still" (Daniel). Just as we have shown, then, if someone reads the Scriptures: for the Lord so instructed his disciples after his resurrection from the dead, showing them from those very Scriptures that it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to enter into his glory, and that in his name repentance for the forgiveness of sins should be preached in all the world. And the disciple will be perfected, becoming like a master of a household who brings forth from his treasure things new and old.

review.notes: The translation accurately captures the Latin text. Pass B correctly identifies the scripture allusions (Daniel and Jeremiah) and provides the necessary verse-level context (though the source text itself only provides the names/allusions, Pass B's inclusion of '(Daniel)' and '(Jeremiah)' as identifiers for the quoted clauses is correct per the instructions to add identifications). Pass B correctly translates 'remissionem peccatorum' as 'repentance for the forgiveness of sins' (a common patristic nuance) and 'patrifamilias' as 'master of a household'.
